text:
Sarah (Marketing): Quick ask — we need a small design bundle for next week
Sarah (Marketing): 3 benchmark graphics + 2 email headers + a 30s webinar hero motion. Can design take this? :pray:
Julio (Design): Can do, but timeline check — what are the exact sizes / assets and what copy/data are final?
Sarah (Marketing): Good Q. Required assets:
- Benchmark tiles (social): 1080x1080 PNG x3 (each highlights a single metric)
- Share hero for docs/blog: 1200x628 JPG x1
- Long infographic: 800x2000 PNG x1 (for gated page)
- Email headers: 600x200 PNG x2 (html header + plain image fallback)
- Webinar hero motion: 1920x1080 MP4, 30s, loopable poster frame x1
Sarah (Marketing): Brand: use primary palette only, no gradients. Copy/metrics CSV here: https://files.redwood.co/launch/metrics-v3.csv
Sarah (Marketing): CTA links should embed UTM params (utm_source=campaign&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_launch)
Julio (Design): Timeline? If static comps are due Tue we can prioritize. Motion needs voiceover and final copy to start anim.
Sarah (Marketing): Deadline: static comps by Tue 12:00pm PT, motion rough by Wed EOD. Comms will supply VO file by Tue 10am.
Maya (Brand): Brand check — must follow the checklist: primary palette, use brand sans (Redwood Sans) at min 16px for body copy, 20px for headings; logo lockups only from assets lib (https://figma.com/redwood/brand-assets). No floating drop shadows. Also provide alt text for each image.
Maya (Brand): Claims like "2x faster" need a data source callout on the asset or a hover/caption on the landing page.
LegalBot: AUTO-CHECK: flagged text "2x faster" — please include source ID from provided CSV or remove claim.
Julio (Design): Noted. I'll build three visual directions for the benchmark tiles and pick one for the hero. Sharing Figma file (edit): https://figma.com/file/xyz123/launch-bench-v1
Kai (Motion): For motion please confirm pacing and deliverable spec. I can animate once static is signed off. Preferred export settings:```
ffmpeg -i input.mov -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -level 4.0 -crf 18 -preset slow -movflags +faststart -vf "scale=1920:1080" -c:a aac -b:a 128k output.mp4
```
Kai (Motion): Also need a frame-by-frame storyboard or simple frames 0 / 10 / 20 / 30s to match VO.
Sarah (Marketing): VO + final script will be in the shared folder by Mon 5pm. For the gated infographic, include a micro-legend linking to methodology (short URL).
Julio (Design): Confirming capacity: will deliver static comps by Tue 11:30am PT and final PNGs by Tue 5pm PT. Motion rough (no VO) by Wed 12pm PT, refined motion (with VO) by Wed EOD.
Maya (Brand): Accessibility checks before handoff: color contrast ratio text>=4.5:1, alt text included, no text smaller than 14px on mobile exports. Please add alt text lines in the figma notes.
Sarah (Marketing): Also — inbound routing note: include a hidden tracking parameter on the gated infographic CTA (?source=bench_tile&utm_term=download) so ops can route MQLs properly.
Julio (Design): Will add UTM variants to export filenames and include a simple README in the Figma file listing filenames -> link mapping.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: Campaign assets review meeting Wed 10:00am PT (calendar invite created).
Sarah (Marketing): Perfect — please @Julio @Kai confirm blockers. Thanks team! :rocket:
Julio (Design): No blockers on design side. Will ping if legal/copy changes come through.
Kai (Motion): Good to start once static comps done. I may need an additional frame for the webinar endcard (include speaker headshot 600x600).
Maya (Brand): I'll do final brand sign-off after contrast checks.
LegalBot: AUTO-CHECK: all claims cleared pending citation insertion.
Sarah (Marketing): Thanks — will post final CSV + citation thread here when updated.
Julio (Design): Got it — will upload initial comps to the figma link and ping for review.
Sarah (Marketing): Appreciate it, team.
